name: Yamaha AS1 / AS2 / AS3 125
engine: 124 cc air-cooled two-stroke parallel twin, Autolube
intro: Small two-stroke twins that rev hard. Common first bikes in the late 1960s and early 1970s.

G: Check the oil injection: the tank feeds the pump, the lines are bled, and the pump cable opens with the throttle.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
